PZZ700-251015-
135 PM PST Tue Nov 24 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1033 mb high was over northeastern Utah, a 1022 mb high
was 250 nautical miles southwest of San Diego, and a 971 mb low 
was 450 miles west of Portland, OR. A weak sea breeze today gives
way to strengthening onshore flow Wednesday with gusts near 15 to
20 knots in the outer coastal waters in the afternoon and 
evening. Combined seas increase to 8-12 feet in the late Wednesday
into Thursday. Seas will begin to lower on Friday and into the 
following weekend. A Small Craft Advisory is in effect from late 
Wednesday morning through late Thursday morning.

$$
